summary: This is a two-channel programmable function generator built around an ESP32-S3 DevKit (U1). Each channel uses an AD9833 DDS (U6/U7) whose output is optionally attenuated, DC-centred and amplified, then scaled by an AD5452 multiplying DAC for amplitude and summed with a second AD5452 for bipolar offset, before driving a 50 Ω output on a coax connector and a 2-pin socket; an ILI9341 touch display and a rotary encoder provide the user interface, and the board runs from a barrel-jack input that produces ±12 V, +10 V, +5 V and +3.3 V.

blocks.name: power-input
blocks.purpose: Barrel-jack input switched by SW2 onto +12C, which feeds the isolated ±12 V converter, the 5 V regulator and the +10 V reference divider.

blocks.name: analog-supply
blocks.purpose: TRACO TEC2-1221WI isolated DC/DC converter that makes the ±12 V op-amp rails from +12C.

blocks.name: logic-supply
blocks.purpose: LM7805 drops +12C to +5V for the DevKit and the AP2112K-3.3 LDO, which supplies the +3.3V logic and DDS/DAC rail.

blocks.name: reference-buffers
blocks.purpose: U15 buffers two filtered dividers: R25/R26 makes a 0.423 V CENTER_BIAS, and R27/R28 makes +10V as 0.833 × +12C, which serves as the DAC and offset reference.

blocks.name: mcu
blocks.purpose: ESP32-S3 DevKit that runs the UI and drives the shared DDS/DAC SPI bus, chip selects and attenuator control lines.

blocks.name: user-interface
blocks.purpose: ILI9341 SPI TFT with resistive-touch controller, plus a rotary encoder with push switch.

blocks.name: ch1-waveform-front-end
blocks.purpose: The AD9833 output passes through the SW3A attenuator select, has CENTER_BIAS subtracted in U4A, and is amplified ×4 in U4B to produce gained_func.

blocks.name: ch1-amplitude-offset-output
blocks.purpose: U8 scales gained_func for amplitude, U9 sets offset from +10V, and U5B sums both with a −10 V bias to drive CH1 through 50 Ω.

blocks.name: ch2-waveform-front-end
blocks.purpose: Channel-2 copy of the front end, using U7, SW3B, R16/R17 and U11.

blocks.name: ch2-amplitude-offset-output
blocks.purpose: Channel-2 copy of the amplitude/offset/summing stage, using U13, U14, U12 and U10B, driving CH2 through 50 Ω.

parts.J3: Barrel-jack DC input (CUI PJ-102AH); pin 1 is GND and pin 2 goes to SW2. The structure finder's 'jumper' label is a misreading of this connector.
parts.SW2: Power switch that connects the barrel-jack positive to +12C.
parts.C1: Input bulk/decoupling capacitor on +12C at U2 and U3.
parts.U2: TEC2-1221WI isolated 2 W DC/DC converter producing +12V and −12V for all OPA2810s; its Remote pin is left unconnected.
parts.U3: LM7805 linear regulator producing +5V from +12C for the DevKit 5V pin and U16.
parts.C2: Radial electrolytic on the LM7805 output / +5V rail.
parts.C32: Ceramic decoupling capacitor on +5V at the AP2112 input.
parts.U16: AP2112K-3.3 600 mA LDO generating +3.3V, with EN tied to VIN so it is always on.
parts.C33: Output capacitor on the +3.3V LDO rail.
parts.R31: 0 Ω link that ties the DevKit's 3V3 pins to the board +3.3V rail, which parallels the DevKit's own regulator with U16.
parts.U1: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-N16R8 main controller, powered from +5V on its 5V pin.
parts.R7: Pull-up that holds U8 (CH1 amplitude DAC) SYNC high, deselected, while GPIO9 is undriven.
parts.R8: Pull-up that holds U9 (CH1 offset DAC) SYNC high while GPIO14 is undriven.
parts.R23: Pull-up that holds U13 (CH2 amplitude DAC) SYNC high while GPIO40 is undriven.
parts.R24: Pull-up that holds U14 (CH2 offset DAC) SYNC high while GPIO41 is undriven.
parts.DS1: ILI9341 TFT with touch controller on a write-only SPI bus (SCK GPIO4, MOSI GPIO5, MISO unconnected), with touch DOUT on GPIO6.
parts.SW1: Rotary encoder module (A/B on GPIO1/GPIO2, push switch on GPIO42), powered from +3.3V.
parts.U15: OPA2810 used as two voltage followers: U15A buffers the 0.423 V CENTER_BIAS, and U15B buffers 0.833 × +12C to create the +10V reference rail.
parts.R25: Top resistor of the CENTER_BIAS divider from +3.3V.
parts.R26: Bottom resistor of the CENTER_BIAS divider, setting 0.423 V.
parts.C15: Filter capacitor on the CENTER_BIAS divider tap.
parts.R27: Top resistor of the +10V divider from +12C; the result is only 10 V when +12C is exactly 12 V.
parts.R28: Bottom resistor of the +10V divider, giving a ratio of 0.833.
parts.C16: Filter capacitor on the +10V divider tap.
parts.U6: AD9833 DDS module generating the CH1 base waveform, selected by FSYNC on GPIO10.
parts.U7: AD9833 DDS module generating the CH2 base waveform, selected by FSYNC on GPIO39.
parts.SW3: TS5A23157 dual SPDT analog switch; per channel (IN1=GPIO21, IN2=GPIO47) it routes the DDS output either directly (NC) or through a 39.2k series resistor (NO) into func_in.
parts.R3: Series arm of the CH1 attenuator, giving ×0.203 with R4 when SW3A selects NO1.
parts.R4: Shunt arm of the CH1 attenuator and DC return for func_in.
parts.R16: Series arm of the CH2 attenuator, giving ×0.203 with R17 when SW3B selects NO2.
parts.R17: Shunt arm of the CH2 attenuator and DC return for func_in.
parts.U4: OPA2810 front end for CH1: U4A computes 5.01·func_in − 4.01·CENTER_BIAS to remove the DDS DC level, and U4B is a ×4 non-inverting stage that drives the U8 VREF pin.
parts.R5: U4A gain resistor from CENTER_BIAS; together with R6 it sets the offset-subtraction gain of 4.01.
parts.U11: OPA2810 front end for CH2, identical to U4.
parts.U8: AD5452 12-bit multiplying DAC that scales CH1 gained_func (on VREF) to set CH1 amplitude, with chip select on GPIO9.
parts.U9: AD5452 multiplying DAC with VREF = +10V that sets the CH1 DC offset, with chip select on GPIO14.
parts.U13: AD5452 multiplying DAC that sets CH2 amplitude from CH2 gained_func, with chip select on GPIO40.
parts.U14: AD5452 multiplying DAC with VREF = +10V that sets the CH2 DC offset, with chip select on GPIO41.
parts.U5: OPA2810 for CH1: U5A is the I-to-V amplifier for U8 (feedback through the DAC's RFB), and U5B is an inverting summer giving CH1 = −(V_U5A + 2·V_U10A + 10 V).
parts.C21: Compensation capacitor across the U5A/U8 transimpedance stage.
parts.U10: OPA2810 whose two halves are the I-to-V amplifiers for the offset DACs: U10A serves U9 (CH1) and U10B serves U14 (CH2).
parts.C27: Compensation capacitor for the U10A/U9 I-to-V stage.
parts.C28: Compensation capacitor for the U10B/U14 I-to-V stage.
parts.U12: OPA2810 for CH2: U12A is the I-to-V amplifier for U13, and U12B is the output summer driving CH2.
parts.C22: Compensation capacitor for the U12A/U13 I-to-V stage.
parts.R29: CH1 summer input from the amplitude path, with unity weight (4.02k/4.02k).
parts.R11: CH1 summer input from the offset DAC, with weight 2 (4.02k/2k), giving about ±10 V of offset span.
parts.R12: CH1 summer input from +10V, with unity weight, that recentres the offset DAC's unipolar range.
parts.R13: U5B feedback resistor that sets the summer gains.
parts.R30: CH2 summer input from the amplitude path, with unity weight.
parts.R15: CH2 summer input from the offset DAC, with weight 2.
parts.R14: CH2 summer input from +10V, with unity weight, used as the offset recentring bias.
parts.R20: U12B feedback resistor that sets the CH2 summer gains.
parts.R1: 50 Ω source/back-termination resistor for the CH1 output.
parts.R2: 50 Ω source/back-termination resistor for the CH2 output.
parts.J4: 2-pin socket carrying the same CH1 output as J1.
parts.J5: 2-pin socket carrying the same CH2 output as J2.

nets.+12C: Switched raw input from the barrel jack that feeds U2, U3 and the +10V divider.
nets.+12V: Positive isolated rail from U2 that powers all OPA2810s.
nets.-12V: Negative isolated rail from U2 that lets the op-amps swing bipolar outputs.
nets.+5V: LM7805 output that powers the DevKit 5V pin and the AP2112 LDO.
nets.+3.3V: AP2112 output that powers the DDS modules, DACs, analog switch, display, encoder and DSYNC pull-ups.
nets.Net-(R31-Pad1): DevKit 3V3 pins, tied to +3.3V through the 0 Ω R31.
nets.+10V: Buffered reference (0.833 × +12C) that feeds the offset DAC VREFs and the summer recentring resistors.
nets.CENTER_BIAS: Buffered 0.423 V that U4A/U11A subtract to centre the DDS waveform around 0 V.
nets.Net-(U15B-IN+): Filtered tap of the +12C divider that sets the +10V level.
nets.GPIO11: Shared SPI data line to both AD9833s and all four AD5452s.
nets.GPIO12: Shared SPI clock line to both AD9833s and all four AD5452s.
nets.GPIO9: SYNC for the CH1 amplitude DAC U8.
nets.GPIO14: SYNC for the CH1 offset DAC U9.
nets.GPIO40: SYNC for the CH2 amplitude DAC U13.
nets.GPIO41: SYNC for the CH2 offset DAC U14.
nets.GPIO21: Selects direct or attenuated DDS signal for CH1 via SW3 IN1.
nets.GPIO47: Selects direct or attenuated DDS signal for CH2 via SW3 IN2.
nets.GPIO4: Shared SCK for the ILI9341 and its touch controller.
nets.GPIO5: Shared MOSI for the ILI9341 and its touch controller.
nets.Net-(SW3A-COM1): Raw CH1 AD9833 output into the analog switch.
nets.Net-(SW3B-COM2): Raw CH2 AD9833 output into the analog switch.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/func_in: Direct or attenuated CH1 DDS signal at the U4A non-inverting input.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/func_in: Direct or attenuated CH2 DDS signal at the U11A non-inverting input.
nets.Net-(U4A-OUT): CH1 waveform with its DC level removed, feeding the ×4 stage U4B.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/gained_func: Amplified CH1 waveform used as the VREF of amplitude DAC U8.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/gained_func: Amplified CH2 waveform used as the VREF of amplitude DAC U13.
nets.Net-(U5A-IN-): U8 IOUT summing node held at virtual ground by U5A.
nets.Net-(U5A-OUT): Amplitude-scaled, inverted CH1 waveform, also the DAC RFB return, feeding summer resistor R29.
nets.Net-(U10A-OUT): CH1 offset voltage (0 to −10 V × code) from U9/U10A, feeding summer resistor R11.
nets.Net-(U10B-OUT): CH2 offset voltage from U14/U10B, feeding summer resistor R15.
nets.Net-(U12A-OUT): Amplitude-scaled, inverted CH2 waveform feeding summer resistor R30.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/10V_ref: Summing junction of the CH1 output summer U5B.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/10V_ref: Summing junction of the CH2 output summer U12B.
nets.CH1: Final CH1 op-amp output before the 50 Ω termination.
nets.CH2: Final CH2 op-amp output before the 50 Ω termination.
nets.Net-(J1-In): 50 Ω-terminated CH1 signal at the coax and the header.
nets.Net-(J2-In): 50 Ω-terminated CH2 signal at the coax and the header.
